cards.issue_title: CIBIL score is a free number; they ask if it should be a dropdown so it does not sit in the same range
summary_4_lines: On Explore banks they go back to the CIBIL score box (it currently shows 780 next to Age 35).
They ask whether to keep that free number as it is, or make it like the dropdown they already used, so the value does not sit in the same range.
One person says keep it like this; they still agree the point of the dropdown pattern is that it must not go in the same range.
ASR said "Sibyl"; the click is the CIBIL score field.
cards.pinpoint: On Explore banks, CIBIL is a free number next to Age; they ask whether to keep it or make it like the dropdown so it does not go in the same range.
cards.on_screen_object: CIBIL score number field #hlc-cibil (780) vs dropdown/FOIR pattern
quotes_sample: Or do we have to keep it the way we did in the drop-down?
So that it doesn't go in the same range?
related_discussion_one_liners: Sit-down continues customer-feedback talk from wb-rec-260815-2222: survey, gift card, talk to every customer, Cursor as first users.
Brand debate: whether the site must look polished for investment versus honest "monster's basement" work — not this CIBIL control.
Launch math: 100 people on the home-loan channel, 2–3 come, grow slowly.
"Every new thing is a new release"; they still need a guide and tools before launch, then "back to Sibyl" and this CIBIL question begins.
cards.distinct_from_other_files_in_this_folder: This is the CIBIL score box as a free number versus the existing dropdown so the value does not sit in the same range; issue-02 is first-land average values plus automatic intelligence then the bank list.

cards.issue_title: Explore banks should land with average values already filled so the recommendation and bank list show at once
summary_4_lines: After the CIBIL question, they say the first time this page lands the user should already see average values filled in.
Then "intelligence" (a recommendation) should appear, and then the bank list — automatically, from the first shot, not only after the visitor fills the form.
They click CIBIL, then monthly income, and say they will try to game that intelligence for real.
ASR "HIF values" is the form fields (average values); they never name a product called HIF.
cards.pinpoint: Explore banks should land with average values already filled so intelligence appears automatically, then the bank list, not only after the visitor fills the form.
cards.on_screen_object: Loan inputs card on first land; recommendation ('intelligence') then bank list
quotes_sample: You have to fill in the HIF values.
And you have to fill in the average intelligence in the first shot.
The intelligence comes and then the list comes.
related_discussion_one_liners: They will try to game the intelligence ("that is the only way you can extract truth out of me").
They did not know this intelligence before.
If input is missing, the real customer may not need that intelligence; missing input has fallacies.

First two customers making the product, YC single-customer trap, one bubble/cohort, bell curve of ₹40,000 vs ₹5 lakh income, need equal samples from every band — sampling talk continues in wb-rec-260815-2240.
Cursor / Discord / gift-card feedback, polish vs basement honesty, and "100 people on the home-loan channel" sit earlier and belong with issue 01's related talk, not as a separate site defect.
